name: Manual acceptance review of the pilot offer and readiness assessment
executionMethod: MCP docs:get followed by complete source recovery and manual comparison with MONETIZATION-P-001/P-002, the source-audited plan and current prerequisite records. This records a document review, not an automated test, customer validation or shipment.
summary: The offer provides a bounded reviewable workflow and explicitly provisional pricing. The readiness matrix identifies existing source authorities, trust boundaries and unresolved launch prerequisites. The real engineering demonstration has saved failing/passing regression receipts; no pilot payment or final-release acceptance is asserted.

assertions.evidence: The offer names small engineering teams/agencies, one repository and four weekly maintenance deliveries in 30 days; segment fit remains a hypothesis.

Each delivery includes a bounded patch, before/after tests and source revision; a named customer maintainer accepts against an agreed command. A no-change investigation requires explicit customer acceptance.

The offer bounds support at two staff hours, excludes an SLA, requires actual contact/timezone before a quote, ends after 30 days without auto-renewal and separates incurred usage from undelivered service fees.

EI-24787677967034419 provides the real maintenance demonstration: saved canonical run20636389 failed before the classifier repair; run20636394 passed afterward. The prior execution checkpoint records6 failing/74 passing then80/80 passing. Current-build plan activation succeeded in this turn. This is an engineering example, not a paying customer case study.

The document retains $500/$1000 price hypotheses, five interview questions and explicit quote fields; measured P003 costs, actual merchant/tax/support details and launch prerequisites must be filled before issuing a quote.
The offer requires a funded finite allowance, stops new spend at exhaustion, forbids automatic top-ups and unapproved overage, and identifies OpenRouter BYOK responsibility.

Fresh plans:get reads show BYOC cloud and capless governor shipped, Stripe signup foundation shipped, carrier draft and portal ready with unfinished acceptance. These statuses are treated as dependency records, not assembled-service readiness.

Fresh WI10005826 read remains wip and held by su-a6555ee3-1fee-4cfb-9d7b-25fd5bd1bde7. Its checkpoint distinguishes fixture suites/build publication from live runtime handoff and deployed signup/cancel proof. The matrix preserves this lane and two $1 test prices.

The matrix keeps source/prompts/transcripts/model I/O customer-side, allows only commercial/control metadata centrally, identifies OpenRouter as a third party and requires sealed-channel and vendor-outage evidence before assembled acceptance.

Current entitlement-seam.ts documents a null allowance patch as no claim, never unlimited. The matrix assigns P004/P005 to accounting and atomic budgets rather than duplicating the existing Stripe subscription stack.

Current model-selection.ts still describes openrouter as a subprocess-only provider. The matrix records P007 execution/key/retention/cost qualification as unresolved and does not equate catalog rates with completed-job costs.

The matrix retains live merchant/payout/tax, support/incident, assembled hosted-account/customer-journey, public-artifact and customer-account acceptance as future gates. Test billing and dependency shipment do not satisfy them.

limitations: Manual document review only; no automated content test is claimed.
No actual customer payment, quoted price validation, live service certification or final shipment is claimed.
P003 must still supply measured workload inputs and a concrete fee-inclusive proposed quote.
